name: Fight Colorectal Cancer
mission: We fight to cure colorectal cancer and serve as relentless champions of hope for all affected by this disease through informed patient support, impactful policy change, and breakthrough research endeavors.
theoryOfChange: Fight CRC is a non-profit organization, providing a safe harbor for a community of patients, caregivers, and families to convene, find support, advocate, and receive balanced information on cancer care, research, and policy. Where many other organizations hold tight to conventional approaches, we take bold actions. We are catalysts for change. We focus our efforts to fund the most promising research endeavors while relentlessly pushing to influence legislation and policy. We are known as fearless friends and empowered fighters, working to bring hope and healing to all affected by colorectal cancer.

strengths_deep_dive: Fight Colorectal Cancer demonstrates strong operational performance through its public accountability credentials and lean fundraising operations. The organization <cite id="1">earned a 98/100 overall score from Charity Navigator</cite> and <cite id="1">meets all 20 BBB Wise Giving Alliance standards</cite>. Directing <cite id="1">80.1% of expenses to program services</cite> allows the organization to beat the standard 75% industry baseline, even though it falls slightly below the peer median of 87.7% for global health organizations. Furthermore, its fundraising operations are cost-effective, <cite id="1">spending just $0.23 per $1 raised</cite>.
rich_narrative.summary: Fight Colorectal Cancer (Fight CRC) is a national advocacy organization focused on patient support, clinical research funding, and policy advocacy. Founded in 2005, the organization <cite id="1">holds a 98/100 overall score from Charity Navigator</cite> and a <cite id="1">Platinum Seal of Transparency from Candid</cite>. In FY2025, the organization recorded <cite id="2">$3,357,068 in total revenue</cite> while maintaining a <cite id="1">program expense ratio of 80.1%</cite>. Fight CRC provides patient education materials, conducts research advocacy training, and organizes policy initiatives such as Call-on Congress. Their programs reached an estimated <cite id="4">600,000 beneficiaries</cite> with resources, including supporting <cite id="4">1,700 clinics nationwide</cite> and distributing <cite id="4">20,000 biomarker brochures</cite>. On the financial front, the charity operates with <cite id="1">high fundraising efficiency, spending $0.23 per $1 raised</cite>, though recent operating expenses have exceeded annual revenue.
